fixer.title: ci: remove the required-checks job now that PR Gate is the required check

introducer.title: ci: skip core test jobs that the changes cannot affect

cases.mechanism: One PR workflow fanned out result aggregation into a 15-entry matrix of hosted runner jobs, duplicating runner startup and status-processing work already performed by PR Gate.
cases.symptom: Every pull request incurred 15 redundant GitHub Actions runner startups and associated compute/status-processing overhead after its core tests.
cases.fixedBehavior: Deleting the entire `required-checks` matrix removes 15 duplicate hosted-runner allocations and their shell/jq work from every PR workflow while retaining one aggregate PR Gate job.
cases.evidence: The deleted `required-checks` job used a 15-entry matrix, so every PR workflow allocated up to 15 additional ubuntu-24.04 runners after the core test jobs completed. Each matrix child started a shell and repeatedly invoked jq only to re-report job results under legacy names. The unchanged `pr-gate` job already depends on every workflow job and performs the same result aggregation once, and branch protection now requires that single gate.
